skillSays: Turns an answer into a checked standalone HTML page: native diagrams (architecture, workflow, sequence, timeline, ERD, tree...) or a one-page explainer.
Chooses the form from the shape of the information: events over time as a timeline, options as a comparison table, numbers as a chart.
An explainer leads with the conclusion, then up to four reasons, then one panel per question, each titled as a question.
Writing rules: short sentences, one term per thing, numbers with units, arithmetic shown once, every derived number recomputed.
Cite sources and state scope. End with a checklist when the reader must act or verify.
It is not a dashboard tool, so a "KPI dashboard" request becomes an answer page about the KPIs.
